data.name: Escape from Track 7
data.detailed_description:
The newest title in the ○番線 anomaly series — over 100,000 copies sold.

The last train has gone. But you are not alone on Track 7.

It is past midnight at a small Japanese railway station. The departure board is blank, the ticket gates are shut, and the only way out lies at the far end of Track 7. Walk the platform. Look closely at everything — the signs, the timetables, the vending machines, the stranger waiting behind the yellow line. Something may be different this time. Or someone.

HOW TO ESCAPE

  • Do not overlook any anomalies.

  • If you find an anomaly, turn back immediately.

  • If there is no anomaly, keep walking.

  • Reach the end to escape from Track 7.

One wrong judgment, and you return to the beginning.

FEATURES

  • 44 anomalies, from nearly invisible details to things you will wish you had never noticed

  • A Japanese railway platform recreated with obsessive, rail-fan levels of detail — the signs, sounds, and signals feel just like the real thing

  • Around 30–60 minutes for one escape; finding every anomaly will keep you on the platform much longer

  • Simple controls: walk, look, decide — no combat

  • Great for streaming: short sessions where your chat can hunt anomalies with you

VIDEO & STREAMING POLICY Streaming and monetized videos of this game are welcome for both individuals and corporations — no permission required. We would appreciate it if you include the game's name in your video title and a link to the Steam page in your description.

data.short_description: The last train is gone, and Track 7 won't let you leave. Watch for anomalies: if something is wrong, turn back; if not, keep walking. One mistake and you start over. A short spot-the-anomaly horror in an eerily real Japanese station, from a series with over 100,000 copies sold.
